description:
The MCP server currently exposes only 11 tools while the CLI has ~34 commands.
This creates a significant gap in what AI agents can accomplish via MCP vs CLI.

Current MCP coverage:
- Discovery: 4 tools (list_platforms, list_benchmarks, get_benchmark_info, system_profile)
- Execution: 4 tools (run_benchmark, dry_run, validate_config, get_query_details)
- Results: 3 tools (list_recent_runs, get_results, compare_results)

Major gaps identified:
- Data preparation (datagen, convert)
- Query plan analysis (show-plan, plan-history)
- Dependency checking (check-deps)
- Performance analytics (report trends, regressions, rankings)
- Result aggregation and export

This TODO adds 7+ new MCP tools and 2 new MCP prompts to close the most important gaps.
